sessions.title: Thinking Controls Behavior
sessions.desc: The Think-Feel-Act cycle, Man A and Man B, automatic thoughts, and the thinking report.

sessions.title: Thinking Errors
sessions.desc: All eight thinking errors, what each sounds like and how it shows up in the dorm, then finding them in your own thinking reports.

sessions.title: Cognitive Restructuring
sessions.desc: The three honest questions, a challenge for every thinking error, the STOP technique, and rewriting a thinking report.

sessions.title: Understanding Emotions
sessions.desc: The emotion wheel, anger as a secondary emotion, where emotions show up in the body, and body mapping.

sessions.title: Emotional Regulation
sessions.desc: The escalation curve, 4-4-4 breathing and 5-4-3-2-1 grounding done along with the video, and when to use which.

sessions.title: The Anger Beneath the Anger
sessions.desc: How unprocessed pain becomes aggression, the four emotions anger covers, and the Beneath My Anger writing exercise. A heavy session, at a calm pace.

sessions.title: Understanding Trauma
sessions.desc: The Three E's, adverse childhood experiences and the private ACE activity, and why trauma is an explanation, not an excuse. A heavy session, at a calm pace.

sessions.title: Trauma Responses in the Dorm
sessions.desc: Fight, flight, freeze and fawn, how they show up in the dorm, and the difference between reacting and responding.

sessions.title: Coping and Safety
sessions.desc: Safe and unsafe coping, a toolkit for when to use what, and building your Safe Coping Card.

sessions.title: Active Listening
sessions.desc: The five components of active listening, the barriers that get in the way, and paired listening practice.

sessions.title: Communication Styles
sessions.desc: The four communication styles, “I” statements, and rewriting five “you” statements.

sessions.title: Giving and Receiving Feedback
sessions.desc: The SBI feedback model, how to receive feedback without getting defensive, and the feedback triad.
